# Grandma Irving & Paul Irving

- [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) — Relative of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — grandmother · since v2  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P36](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0036), +4 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school year and walks home, meeting young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) on her way to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery. They discuss their loved ones, imagination, and placing flowers on graves. At the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together while discussing teaching, ideals, friendship, and future plans.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's passing, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) come to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne.md) can attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts the opportunity with mixed emotions and resigns her teaching post, prompting reactions from her pupils and [Diana](../character/diana.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior to [Anne](../character/anne.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to promise to return for a extended visit to cheer her up. After a outdoors tea with strawberries, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) sits with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in the garden and shares stories about her imaginary dream-boy, which resonates deeply with Paul's own imagination before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> After school finishes for the year, town mothers discuss Anne's departure for college, the upcoming loss of Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's unique imagination. [Anne](../character/anne.md) stays at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), then meets [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and learns he wants to reconnect with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) excitedly helps arrange their reunion, helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare as [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) arrives at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace
